name: autofab
description: A chip fab run by Nemotron agents on Crusoe that learns between shifts.

agents.description: Turns an order into a plan and a definition of done; spawns one designer per part.
Designs one part as a blueprint, reusing verified library parts first.
Wires parts into the top-level blueprint; every port connected.
Flattens, tests every input, checks fab rules. Never trusts self-reports.
Looks at the drawn failed circuit and names the wrong wire.
Categorizes failures, detects loops in thinking traces, writes lessons in the fault's words.
Proposes one factory change per shift; kept only if a fresh validation batch improves.
